sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must performed 
on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

المواصفات الفنية للمولد الرئيسي: الجهد المقنن 15.75 كيلو فولت & 
تصنيف الجزء الثابت الحالي 7560A. التردد المقدر 50 هرتز والسرعة المقدرة 100 دورة في الدقيقة. 
الطاقة المقدرة 175 / 206 ميجاوات / ميجا فولت أمبير

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Ragab Mohamed, reviewed by 
eng. Gamal Hassan, 
accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad general 
director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector of High 
Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.

This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح عمل، والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.
مطلوب سياج أمان (حبل) مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل.
Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass
Switch off the CB (B-1G) 15.75 kv figure (1).
Switch off the unit isolator (P-1G) 15.75 kv
Switch off the VT of (M.G-AUX.G) for the unit

Switch off the automatic`s (F403 DC control of 
 the start / stop unit operation), 72 D2-7(DC auto. for control of CB, 
 unit filed and B.F protection), 72A111,(A.C auto. control supply circuit for 
 auditing rotor of AUX. G insulation device), 72A-13 (A.C auto. for control supply 
 circuit of auditing rotor of M.G insulation device), 14 AG (AC auto. for control circuit of 
 for the unit. Disconnector)
Switch off the AJB (on/off switch for AUX. G)

Shunt rheostats (the resistance for control voltage of AUX. G) in max. 
 resistance value position
Switch on the earths for (M.G (Z-1G), AUX.G(Z-1BG) of the unit

Stoppers on (blocking for servo motor), close valve no. 7(controller in the 
 entrance pressure in two direction open / close gates)
Switch on the two supplies of (high pressure pump)
Presence of industrial safety supervisor .

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Dismantle one iron plate 
above aux. generator

Dismantle bus bars of aux. 
generator and put insulation wedges between the terminals

Dismantle the brushes of (M.G 
& AUX.G & exc. G) for the unit

Dismantle bus bars of V.T, 
reactor isolator and reactor earth for M.G.

Perform H.V test for (M.G. 
& AUX. G)

Dismantle bus bars of (M.G) 
and star point

Dismantle four-iron plate, 
for (M.G) plus two plates for carastavena and two plates above M.G windinga

Take sample oil for 
chemical test

تحقق من الفرش 
الجنرال المثير وقياس الفجوة الهوائية للجنرال المثير.

Clean the air filters by 
used air vacuum and clean the slip rings

Clean the main and aux. 
poles for D.C gen.

Check the brushes and 
slips rings for (M.G & AUX.) gen.

Clean the surface of the 
rotor for the (M.G) and clean upper parts of poles surface.

Check the connection tight 
between the poles

Measure the air gap 
between the rotor and stator for five poles for each quarter

Clean the surface of 
stator of M.G

Dismantle two M.G poles 
for good cleaning and mantle them after that

Perform blackout and prob. 
test for stator of M.G.

Retighten all the bus bars 
for the unit
